description: Change of use of the dwelling to a C4 HMO
decision_conditions: <p>The proposed development fails to demonstrate&nbsp;that additional demand for parking from the development could be adequately accommodated in the surrounding area.&nbsp;especially as the application site is located within the HW Controlled Parking Zone (CPZ), where on‑street parking demand is already managed through restrictions. The proposal is therefore likely to&nbsp;exacerbate existing parking stress within the CPZ thus&nbsp;add unacceptably to parking stress and congestion in the vicinity of the application site.&nbsp;As such, it fails to comply with the following policies&nbsp;which seek to ensure proposals show how car parking will be designed and managed and to take into consideration on-street parking availability and existing and planned public transport provision:</p><ul><li>National Planning Policy Framework (December 2024)</li><li>Policies T1, T6 and T6.1 of the London Plan (March 2021)</li><li>Policy DMT2 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)</li></ul>

<p>The proposed development results in the loss of a family-sized dwellinghouse, the need for which is clearly demonstrated in the development plan and supporting evidence base. While it would provide a dwelling in the form of an HMO, it fails to demonstrate that there&nbsp;is an identified need and has failed to provide information&nbsp;regarding the frequency of the third resident's occupancy thus, the proposed use of the dwelling is defined as a C4 HMO.&nbsp;As such, the proposal is considered to have a detrimental impact on the borough's supply of family housing and is contrary to the following policies:</p><ul><li>National Planning Policy Framework (December 2024)</li><li>Policies&nbsp;D6, D14 and T4&nbsp;of the London Plan (March 2021)</li><li> Policies SP3, SP8, DMD1, DMT1, DMH5 and DMSI3&nbsp;of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)</li></ul>

<p>The proposed development would fail to provide sufficient internal space for the overall GIA and one of the bedrooms and would therefore provide a substandard quality of accommodation detrimental to the standard of living of future residents. Therefore, the proposal fails to comply with:&nbsp;</p><ul><li>National Planning Policy Framework (MHCLG, December 2024);</li><li>Policy D6 of the London Plan (March 2021); and&nbsp;</li><li>Policy&nbsp;DMH5 (Houses in multiple occupation (HMOs)) of&nbsp;&nbsp;the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan&nbsp;(September 2024)</li></ul>
borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
